items.title: HumanTracker: Towards Comprehensive and Human-Aligned Motion Tracking Benchmark
items.title_cn: HumanTracker ：迈向全面、人性化的运动跟踪基准
items.summary: Humanoid motion tracking is central to teleoperation and whole-body imitation, yet evaluation often disagrees with what people perceive in videos. Kinematic errors average per-frame pose differences but miss the physical artifacts that matter most, particularly unstable support and incorrect contact...
